response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not match this role's core requirements. His professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. He has no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience, and no evidence of deep SQL Server/Oracle work. His recent decade has centered on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, making the gap to this specialized C++ finance role too large.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, and systems programming
Proven low-latency, high-throughput development experience (DLang at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, and open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and it dates back to 2015
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience, nor Windows-platform C++ development

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and low-latency systems background
